sources.beginner: hand-calc/prompt-given: the prompt's own summary (6 primary only, 10 secondary only, 3 both, nineteen elements) dictates the four as-found counts; the as-found and as-secured tables it cites exist only in /root/dr-wip-integrity/dr11_fields.mjs:71-121, not on any learner surface (IntegrityLearningPage.jsx:310-311 renders only title and prompt; EnvelopeExplorer.jsx:83 has only the golden roster), so the two as-secured counts are unobtainable.
sources.intermediate: unobtainable: the Kestrel A-7 annulus inputs (ratings 5220/4040/3450/5000 psi, LOT densities, fluid densities, MDs on the D1 survey) are in /root/dr-wip-integrity/dr11_fields.mjs:127-142 only; the prompt carries no numbers and src/components/course/panels/integrity/AnnulusExplorer.jsx takes only densities over the golden's fixed elements, printing MPa to 4 decimals (AnnulusExplorer.jsx:19).
sources.advanced: unobtainable: the P&A geometry and depths live only in /root/dr-wip-integrity/dr11_fields.mjs:145-177; the prompt gives only '35 percent excess', and src/components/course/panels/integrity/PaExplorer.jsx edits only hole ID and stinger OD on the golden plug (PaExplorer.jsx:62-63), printing volumes to 6 decimals, settle and takeoff to 4.
